heading: Tonight
text: Any storms ending, then showers diminishing overnight. Valley fog developing, with dense fog forming along the rivers. Lows in the 50s to near 60. Light north wind.

heading: Friday
text: Variable clouds and sun, with more sunshine developing in the afternoon. Chance of a few passing showers, and isolated afternoon storms. Highs in the 70s to low 80s. Light north wind.

heading: Friday Night
text: Increasing cloud cover overnight. Lows from the upper 50s to low 60s. Calm wind.
